text.description_html:
First Impressions Solid Brass 2-5/8 Inch Wall Mount Decorative Door Stop

These decorative solid brass door stops screw onto the baseboard casement or door bottom, to protect the door hardware and wall. Traditional designer styling and hand finished by the master craftsmen at First Impressions International, in your choice of high quality finish.

Also available: Other Decorative Door Stops by First Impressions.

Specifications for First Impressions FII-MG25 Decorative Door Stop

  • Length: 2-5/8"
  • Includes 1" Long Mounting Screw Stud
  • Bumper Tip: White
  • Solid Brass

No matter which finish you choose for the outside, it will still be solid brass material inside.

** This item is being discontinued. Very limited quantities available.
